name: glass-night-veil-verify-off
description: GLASS-NIGHT-VEIL + EXTERIOR-FACE-DAYLIGHT, the FLAG-OFF twin of glass-night-veil-verify.json: the pre-fix render, with the night pane still at ~0.81 transmission and the exterior shell faces still on the bare analytic fill. Same poses and hours, so each pair diffs one change. Run with SHOT_GPU=1 and SHOT_URL='http://localhost:5200/?ff=glassNightVeil:off,exteriorFaceDaylight:off'.

steps.name: capture-init
steps.eval: (() => { window.__veil = { logs: [] }; const info = console.info.bind(console); console.info = (...a) => { const s = String(a[0]); if (s.includes('lightmaps:')) window.__veil.logs.push(s); info(...a) } })()

steps.name: setup
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.dismissChecklist?.(); s.setManualHour?.(20); s.setTimeMode?.('manual'); s.setLightsMode?.('on'); s.setQualityTier?.('realistic'); s.setDeviceClass?.('capable'); s.hideLoading?.(); s.setFeatureFlag?.('interactiveDegrade', false) })()

steps.name: pin-device-class
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store; s.getState().setDeviceClass('capable'); s.setState({ setDeviceClass: () => {} }) })()

steps.name: probe-pane
steps.eval: (() => { const out = []; window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh) return; const m = Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material[0] : o.material; if (m && (m.transmission ?? 0) > 0.5) out.push(+m.transmission.toFixed(4)) }); let boosted = 0; const seen = new Set(); window.__three.scene.traverse(o => { if (!o.isMesh) return; const ms = Array.isArray(o.material) ? o.material : [o.material]; for (const m of ms) { const u = m && m.userData && m.userData.visExteriorUniform; if (u && !seen.has(u)) { seen.add(u); if (u.base > 0) boosted++ } } }); console.log('[probe]', JSON.stringify({ paneTransmission: out.slice(0, 4), boostedMaterials: boosted })) })()

steps.name: pose-living-night
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 4.2); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.02) })()

steps.name: pose-living-near-down
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(10.9, 2.3); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.18) })()

steps.name: pose-bedroom-day
steps.eval: (() => { const l = window.__walkLook; l.setPosition(1.7, 2.6); l.setYaw(0); l.setPitch(-0.05) })()

steps.name: frame-iso
steps.eval: (() => { const { camera, controls } = window.__three; controls.enableDamping = false; camera.position.set(18,12,16); controls.target.set(6.3,0.8,4.5); controls.update(); controls.update(); controls.update(); window.__three.invalidate(); window.__three.advance(performance.now()) })()
